notes: Bangkok-wide v1 covers the 50 Bangkok administrative districts.
The bbox is derived from the staged 50-district geometry and is only an extraction envelope.
Events are clipped to district polygons before road matching, so bbox corner areas outside Bangkok are excluded.
Urban network: named tertiary roads with sufficient in-Bangkok length.
The four original pilot roads retain stable IDs for continuity only; they receive no special Bangkok-wide visual or sampling priority.
Traffic sampling uses a configurable internal request budget and rotating district-aware plan; it is not a provider quota.
BMA official district geometry remains the intended authoritative replacement when automated access is stable.
